subject.title: [Feature]: Ali bailian coding plan support ( thinking/reasoning enabled )

question: Should OpenClaw officially enable Ali Bailian/Qwen Coding Plan reasoning through bundled Qwen catalog entries, custom Bailian provider configs, or both?
rationale: Source inspection shows a real capability gap, but the permanent support boundary depends on vendor proof and maintainer acceptance of model- and region-specific provider behavior.

options.title: Land verified slices
options.body: Review the open custom-provider and catalog PRs as verified slices, then close this issue only after merged coverage or an explicit documented remainder.

options.title: Request one consolidated fix
options.body: Ask contributors to combine bundled catalog, custom-provider inference, docs, and tests into one Qwen-provider PR after vendor verification.

options.title: Defer broad support
options.body: Keep the current conservative behavior and require stronger model-by-model Alibaba proof before changing bundled catalog reasoning flags.

recommendation.title: Land verified slices
recommendation.body: Review the open custom-provider and catalog PRs as verified slices, then close this issue only after merged coverage or an explicit documented remainder.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the original Qwen provider surface and already routed the issue discussion around the provider-boundary decision.
